module.purpose: Provides branded fractional ordering keys and helper functions for generating, validating, and sorting ordered data.
module.summary: This utility module wraps fractional-indexing generators behind a stable IndexKey API. It selects deterministic generation in test environments and jittered generation otherwise, normalizes optional bounds to null, exposes helpers for positions above, below, or between existing keys, and supplies comparators for indexed and optionally indexed records.
module.businessContext: Supports stable ordering of application entities such as shapes or records without reindexing entire collections. Failures can produce invalid ordering, misplaced entities, or nondeterministic insertion behavior.
classes: IndexKey (~L16): Branded string type representing a fractional ordering key
functions: validateIndexKey (~L33-39): Validates strings and reports invalid ordering keys
getIndicesBetween (~L53-59): Generates multiple ordering keys between optional bounds
getIndicesAbove (~L73-75): Generates multiple ordering keys above an optional lower bound
getIndicesBelow (~L89-91): Generates multiple ordering keys below an optional upper bound
getIndexBetween (~L105-110): Generates one ordering key between optional bounds
getIndexAbove (~L123-125): Generates one ordering key above an optional lower bound
getIndexBelow (~L139-141): Generates one ordering key below an optional upper bound
getIndices (~L155-157): Generates a starting key and additional sequential ordering keys
sortByIndex (~L175-182): Compares records using their required ordering keys
sortByMaybeIndex (~L190-201): Compares records while ordering missing keys last

env: Reads process.env.NODE_ENV once at module initialization to select the key generator.
